ModMetaData.name: Immersive Raid Compression
ModMetaData.author: lyj
ModMetaData.description:
Reduces oversized late-game human and mechanoid raids by replacing groups of low-tier enemies with fewer, stronger vanilla pawn kinds. It does not add hidden combat stat buffs.
通过使用派系原本拥有的高阶人类兵种或机械体型号，减少后期超大规模袭击的单位数量。不添加隐藏战斗属性 Buff。
